steps.description: Pre-filter to genes with at least 10 counts in at least 6 samples (the smallest group size). Set condition as a factor with an explicit reference level of 'control'/'vehicle' (name exactly as it appears in metadata.csv). Estimate DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors internally (no pre-normalization of counts), fit the negative binomial GLM, run the Wald test for the contrast condition treated_vs_control, and apply apeglm shrinkage to the log2 fold change of that coefficient. plan.title: Aldosterone vs vehicle kidney: DE + TF activity drivers
plan.analytical_narrative: 6 aldosterone-treated vs 6 vehicle-control human kidney samples, raw Salmon gene-level counts, unpaired single-batch design (12000 genes x 12 samples in count matrix + 1 sample in metadata beyond design scope note). We run the grounded DESeq2 pipeline: blind-VST sample-structure QC, minimal count pre-filter, DESeq2 Wald test with explicit condition reference level (control), apeglm shrinkage, BH multiple testing with independent filtering. Because the research question specifically asks which transcription factors drive the treated-vs-control response (top 6 per group/direction), the central analysis step is decoupleR univariate linear model (ulm) TF-activity inference on the CollecTRI human regulon network, run on the DESeq2 Wald statistic of every tested gene (not just significant genes), which is the grounded method for this exact question. A pathway-level enrichment (over-representation analysis on the significant DE gene list against MSigDB Hallmark/Reactome/WikiPathways, universe = tested genes) is added as mechanistic context around the TF activity result per the knowledge-service enrichment ruling (ranked fgsea was rejected as a permitted enrichment method for this situation; ORA with explicit universe is the sanctioned alternative). A final report step integrates DE results, TF activity ranking (top 6 activated / top 6 repressed TFs), and enrichment context, with full reproducibility reporting (versions, seed, thresholds, session info).

steps.method: DESeq2 vst(blind) + PCA + sample distance heatmap
Keep genes with >=10 counts in >=6 samples (smallest group size)
apeglm shrinkage on the treatment coefficient
decoupleR ulm on CollecTRI regulons using the DESeq2 Wald statistic
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark
Combined DE + TF activity + enrichment report
fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic (stat column) against MSigDB Hallmark gene sets, followed by Reactome and WikiPathways as second collections
Over-representation analysis with an explicit universe of tested genes, on the significant DE gene list, against MSigDB Hallmark, Reactome and WikiPathways
